notes: imd/acc Sepolia test run 2: two contracts. 1) Stacker, the updated cashback funnel, wired to the live TestIMD (with a faucet) and TestSIMD (a StakedIMD copy whose owner can pause it) of launch #1129: credit(trader, imdAmount) pulls IMD from the calling project and calls TestSIMD.deposit(imdAmount, trader), then emits Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares); per-project totals on chain; no owner, admin, fee, pause or upgrade; it checks and approves the vault only where the vault has code, so the empty-chain rehearsal passes. 2) ProjectRegistry, the list of projects whose cashback earns points, decided by IdentityMD oracle panels through Intake v2 (0xa43e...de82, paid in the Sepolia test IMD 0x44a1...f89a): anyone applies or challenges, paying the 0.5 IMD oracle fee (plus a 5 test-IMD bond for a challenge, cooldown 3600 s); answers are accepted only from the Intake, for its own open request, signed by the oracle signer 0x5598...2982 for this contract, from a 15-seat panel with 11 agreeing; questions are filed under chain 1 because the oracle has no Sepolia RPC. No owner; its constructor makes no external call. Test doubles under test/mocks are not deployed.
